steps.observation: You have 60 seconds. What are three strategies for reducing carbon emissions in cities?

steps.action:
1. Sustainable urban mobility  
   • Invest in and expand public transit (e.g., bus rapid transit, light rail)  
   • Create safe infrastructure for walking and cycling (protected bike lanes, pedestrian zones)  
   • Incentivize electric and low-emission vehicles with charging stations and preferential lanes  

2. Energy-efficient buildings  
   • Enforce stricter building codes for insulation, windows, and HVAC systems  
   • Retrofit existing housing and offices with LED lighting, smart thermostats, and high-performance glazing  
   • Offer subsidies or low-interest loans for energy-saving upgrades  

3. Clean, local energy supply  
   • Install rooftop solar, district geothermal, or small-scale wind in neighborhoods and public buildings  
   • Partner with utilities for green power purchase agreements or municipal renewable microgrids  
   • Implement smart-grid technologies and energy storage to balance supply and demand
